title: The blank last page
surface: When a girl reached the last page of a book, she smiled. There was not a single word on it, and she had been nervous until then. What happened?
solution: The girl was inspecting a collection of her own handwriting practice that she had just bound into a book. She was worried that ink on the reverse of the last sheet had bled through onto the final page. She was checking the finished book page by page, not reading a story. Finding the final page clean, with no ink showing through, made her smile with relief.

facts.text: This is the girl’s own collection of handwriting practice, and she is checking the finished binding.
She feared ink had bled through onto the final page; finding it clean showed that it had not.

unknowns: The girl’s age is not specified.
hints: She was not worried about how a story would end.
The book was connected to her own work.
She was checking marks on the paper.
